Behind every data point

A NOTE ON THE NUMBERS

Good comparisons start with context.

Measured trials, preserved

The default view includes completed trials. The runner discards successful warm-ups before export; warmup=true is a configuration flag. Failed and aborted records can be included using the status filter, but may contain partial measurements.

Transparent aggregation

Each measured trial has equal weight. Missing and unsupported values are omitted, never replaced with zero. Choose mean, median, or an interpolated 95th percentile. Broad selections can mix different scene and map workloads.

Know the measurement

FPS comes from animation-frame timing, not a count of GPU-presented frames. Memory metrics are separate, potentially overlapping observations. Raster coverage is a geometric proxy. PNGs include the active selection and aggregation method.
